newsitem.title: UK: GDR REPORT-India GDRs down following Bombay slip.
newsitem.headline: GDR REPORT-India GDRs down following Bombay slip.

text.p: Indian global depositary receipts were lower on Friday following losses in Bombay and in line with the market's recent consolidation, traders said.
They said prices were likely to be capped in the near term amid jitters in local markets following Prime Minister Inder Kumar Gujral's warning about raising petroleum product prices.
Also, the expected vote next week on the 1997/8 budget was seen limiting interest in the near term.
Another trader said the market was likely to drift amid a lack of any positive news, with only corporate results likely to offer direction to individual stocks.
Hindalco eased 50 cents to $31.50/$32.50, while Reliance shed 55 cents to $19.00/$20.00.
The HSBC James Capel Indian GDR index closed 0.89 points down at 78.61, with the premium over the local market at 17.86 percent versus 18.72 percent.
Taiwanese GDRs fell in line with losses in Taipei, where a recent bull run has come under pressure from political and economic uncertainty.
The Capel Taiwan GDR Index shed 7.75 points, or 6.17 percent, to 117.89, representing a discount to the local market of 3.42 percent.
The Capel Korea GDR Index made 1.04 points to 62.10 points, a premium of 27.73 percent over the local market.
